en: Vintage postal card with ornate printed design and handwritten address in ink. A circular postmark at the top right reads "ROMA" indicating it was sent from Rome. The printed background includes decorative borders and text bands typical of early 20th‑century international reply cards. The word "CARTE POSTALE" is printed in red at the top center. The address is written in Spanish, directed to Madrid, Spain.
